text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Sirius Symboli overcame a field of strong 
rivals to claim 1st place in the Japan 
Cup.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
With this brilliant performance serving as 
the deciding factor, Sirius Symboli's 
two-year overseas campaign plan was 
approved by the URA.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Realizing that she had unknowingly become 
a beacon for her juniors who dream of 
going overseas, Sirius Symboli shifted her 
course toward entering the Arima Kinen.
